atoms.sound: Scottish Culture. The culture of the Scots is rich. It includes various aspects: traditions, such as the Highland Games, sports, film, music, dance, food and drinks, languages and so forth. The spoken languages are unique. Since the 18th century, English has been the main spoken language. However, originally dominating the Highlands and isles, Gaelic is said to be the founding language of the country. At the same time, Scots emerged as the language of the Lowlands. It is more closely related to English than Gaelic. The official languages if Scotland are English, Gaelic, Scots and, since 2003, British Sign Language.

atoms.a: Tablet is a Scottish dessert that is similar to fudge. It is made of sugar, milk and butter. Those sweets are medium-hard and can be combined with nuts, ice cream or chocolate.
Black pudding is not sweet. It is actually a traditional Scottish blood sausage and consists of pork blood baked together with other ingredients like oatmeal or barley groats.
